name: Creatinine
summary: Creatinine is a waste product from normal muscle activity. Healthy kidneys filter it out, so its blood level is used to estimate kidney function.

high.meaning: A high creatinine can mean the kidneys are filtering less well. It is also higher in people with more muscle and after heavy exercise or a large meat meal.

low.meaning: A low creatinine usually reflects low muscle mass and is rarely a concern on its own.

sources.title: KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of Chronic Kidney Disease
